_comment: Factory settings for this repo. Layers over global/factory/factory.config.json (the kit's own defaults); unset keys fall through to it. The deployed engine lives in .factory/ and the workflows in .github/workflows/factory-*.yml -- both are MIRRORS of global/factory/ and global/workflows/, same canonical-source pattern as .claude/skills/ mirroring global/skills/. Change global/, then re-deploy; never edit the mirror. Full guide: docs/factory-playbook.md.
_comment_dry_run: Stays true until a few conductor ticks have been read and judged sensible. Turning it off is the decision to let this thing open pull requests unattended -- make it deliberately.
_comment_runner: The factory runs on the WSL2 pool on the Windows desktop (runner-kit-1 / runner-kit-2, labels self-hosted+factory+wsl). Set the FACTORY_RUNNER repository variable to ["self-hosted","factory"]. require_self_hosted then fails a job that lands on a GitHub-hosted runner instead of quietly spending Actions minutes.
_comment_budget: Deliberately lower than a single-repo default would be: this subscription also backs HockeyManagerPortal's factory and a human at a terminal, and the governor's budget is PER REPO -- two repos each reserving 40% still leaves the pair able to spend more than either number suggests. Start small, read the ledger, then raise.
_comment_audits: docs-drift first, and alone. This repo IS documentation -- eight readmes, a playbook, a changelog and a README that all describe the same assets -- so drift here is both the likeliest defect and the cheapest to verify. Turn on a second audit only once this one has filed something worth acting on.
